ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high-intensity pixels are primarily concentrated in the distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular high-intensity contiguous areas located on the outer halves of the left and right lobes. These areas are heavily interspersed with low-intensity stippling, mottling, and linear streaks. The central fluke region and the perimeter are dominated by solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. Notable macro-notches and jagged peaks (amplitude ranging from 5 to 15 pixels) are visible, particularly on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the leading edge transition towards the tips; trailing edge maintains a generally convex sweep but is heavily disrupted by serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-4 pixel diameter) localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct low-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white patches; most prominent on the left lobe as a pair of intersecting diagonal lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation and apparent tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch.
